data.long_meaning: The one who holds the crown or the sovereign. The name Esfand carries the meaning “Crown” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Esfand usually hope their child will grow to embody crown and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and the ultimate goal of achieving a crown of wisdom and understanding.
data.etymology: Esfand belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Crown.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Esfand total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: اِسفَند
in_arabic.meaning: اسم شهر در گاه شمار فارسی و ایرانی
in_arabic.long_meaning: اِسفَند هوَ الاسم العربي لشهر فروردين، في تقويم شمسي. وهوَ من أشهر الاسماء الفارسية المأخوذة من الجدول الرباعي، ويستخدم في العديد من اللغات العربية. يحمل اسم اِسفَند معنى «الخريف»، و يرمز في الثقافة الشعبية إلى نهاية الصيف والبداية من موسم الربيع. في الإسلام، يعتبر شهر اِسفَند من أشهر الشهور، حيث كان يُعتبر من أفضل الأوقات لعبادة الله. ومع ذلك، لم يذكر الشهر في القرآن الكريم.

in_urdu.name: اِسفَند
in_urdu.long_meaning: اِسفَند فارسی تقویم کا چھٹا مہینہ ہے۔ اس میں 31 دن ہوتے ہیں۔ اس مہینے کا نام فارسی میں 'اِسفَند' ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'خزاں'۔ اس مہینے کا آغاز فروری کے پہلے دن ہوتا ہے اور اسی مہینے کا آخری دن مارچ کے پہلے دن ہوتا ہے۔ اس مہینے کا نام اسلامی تقویم میں 'ربیع الاول' ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ईसफंद
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईसफंद फ़ारसी कैलेंडर का छठा महीना है। इसमें 31 दिन होते हैं। इस महीने का नाम फ़ारसी में 'ईसफंद' है जिसका अर्थ है 'ख़रीफ़'। इस महीने का प्रारंभ फरवरी के पहले दिन होता है और इसी महीने का अंतिम दिन मार्च के पहले दिन होता है। इस महीने का नाम इस्लामी कैलेंडर में 'रबीअल अव्वल' है।

in_pashto.name: اسفند
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسفند د پښتينې کېلنډر کال سيتمه مېنه ده. په دې مېنه کې 31 ورځې دي. دا مېنه د پښتينې تېلو په مينه کې 'اسفند' په نوم يادېږي چې دا 'خريف' پېښه کوي. په افغانستان کې د اسفند مېنه د ځوانانو او شابانو لپاره ځانګړي مېنه دی، ځکه چې په دې مېنه کې پوځي سلاکونه او د ځوانانو د غورځنګونه د پښتو ټولپېژندنې د تاريخي يادښتونو په توګه يادونه کوي.

in_english.name: Esfand
in_english.meaning: The sixth month of the Persian calendar, literally means 'winter' or 'drying up'
in_english.long_meaning: Esfand is the sixth month of the Persian calendar. It has 31 days. In Arabic, the name 'Esfand' means 'winter' or 'drying up'. In Islamic tradition, Esfand is one of the most important months, as it marks the beginning of the new year. In Persian culture, Esfand is associated with renewal and rejuvenation, and is often referred to as the 'month of hope'. In Islamic tradition, Esfand is a time for self-reflection and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: Esfand is considered the last month of the Iranian calendar, and it marks the end of the year. During this month, various traditional Iranian festivals and holidays take place, such as Dehghan, Sadeh, and the last ten days of the year leading to Nowruz, the Persian New Year. These celebrations revolve around paying homage to fire, enjoying good food, and gathering with family and friends.
data.spiritual_significance: Esfand represents the concept of sovereignty and leadership on a spiritual level. It is a time for reflection and striving for self-mastery, as individuals are reminded of their inherent potential as divine beings within the larger scheme of the universe. It may be a period of realizing limitations and confronting them, as we strive to manifest personal growth and independence, aligning more closely with our true self and the divine will.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Crown" symbolizes The one who holds the crown or the sovereign.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Esfand serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of crown.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Esfand is the twelfth month of the Iranian calendar. The name Esfand carried significant weight in that era.
